skill_name: Write a brief essay about how data privacy affects society.
workflow: Data privacy has become a crucial part of modern life, as the amount of data collected, stored and shared by both individuals and companies has grown exponentially. Data privacy affects society in several ways. Firstly, it ensures that individuals are aware of what data is being collected about them and how it is being used.
